why: Both moved the same five call sites with equal verification, but A's system-level work is more rigorously measured and more correct: it caught that OpenManus screenshots are PNG while format_messages labels every image image/jpeg (proven as 6x 400s from Anthropic), fixed it with tests alongside the catalog-driven vision gate, A/B'd the cache key on both vendors and recorded the result that contradicted the house doc, verified Flex pricing, and labelled spend by [llm.*] config name — the dimension this multi-agent app actually needs. B's migration moves marginally more traffic and has three sharp items A lacks (provider_timeout matched to the agent's own 300s deadline, the tiktoken-based max_input_tokens guard being wrong for non-OpenAI models, and the browser-use MCP egress), but its flagship vision branch would ship the jpeg/PNG 400 straight into production, and neither engineer reached the CTO bar — no spend caps, shadow models, Jev, Switchyard, per-step model tiering, or any question of whether a given call should be a smaller model or no model at all.
A_best: Going live on the vision path surfaced a latent, pre-existing media-type bug and fixed it with 11 tests, gated so non-Router deployments keep the old behaviour; paired with honest m7 (config.toml is gitignored, so this may move nothing) and a measured Flex finding that correctly concludes 'change nothing'.
B_best: provider_timeout set per feature to mirror the app's own 300s agent-loop deadline (Router kills a generation the client already abandoned, and truncated attempts are still billed), plus the model-map target chosen as claude-sonnet-4-6 rather than the cheaper claude-sonnet-5 because the latter's catalog entry rejects temperature and would silently change sampling for configs pinned at 0.0.
A_worst: The unlock list is three hard-coded hosts rather than the configured host, and the deepest items (Bedrock port, VMind port, Azure) are gestured at as i6-i9 without the substance shown; no spend caps, shadow models, Jev/Switchyard, or any per-call-site model tiering for an app that sends every step to one frontier model.
B_worst: The vision branch derives MULTIMODAL_MODELS from the catalog at import time with no media-type fix and no active() gate, so PNG screenshots to Anthropic-served models will 400 (A measured exactly that), and it folds model choice, fallbacks and Flex into a single 'needs-decision' punt instead of a ranked recommendation.
